title: Workflow reachability exceptions
description: Declared exceptions to scripts/ci/verify-workflow-reachability.mjs. An entry asserts that a job inheriting a skipped upstream, or a script outside its workflow's push path filter, is a reviewed decision rather than the silent-failure defect documented in docs/CI_RELEASE_RUNBOOK.md.

documentation.description: Path to the runbook explaining both failure modes.

purpose.description: Why this file exists, for a reader who found it via a failing gate.

skipPropagation.description: Jobs allowed to inherit a skipped upstream through `needs` without carrying a status-check function.

pathsCoverage.description: Scripts a workflow executes that are intentionally absent from its push path filter.

reason.description: Why this is safe, or an explicit statement that it was baselined without individual review. The verifier rejects reasons under 20 characters so a token string cannot buy an exemption.

workflow.description: Workflow file name as it appears in .github/workflows.

job.description: Job key exactly as declared under `jobs:`.
Path coverage is a whole-workflow property, so this is always "*".

path.description: Repo-relative path of the executed script or transitively imported module.
